summary: Side-effect-only module that calls setFlagsFromString('--enable-experimental-regexp-engine-on-excessive-backtracks') in a try/catch. It lives in hooks/ (with an empty regex-engine.d.mts) because hook scripts never import from dist/ while src/index.ts can reach into hooks/. It only covers regexes created after it runs, so it must be the first import of each process entry point.
